course_outline_concepts: Skalse-style taxonomy + LM-specific hacks: length bias, sycophancy, refusal-over-training, format abuse
Judge-LLM biases (Zheng 2023 MT-Bench): position, verbosity, self-enhancement
Constitutional AI + RLAIF + synthetic judges - Con-J, Self-Taught Evaluators, J1 line
Lilian Weng's reward-hacking survey - generalised mitigations
Pre-deployment detection: red-team evals, RM-vs-RM disagreement, diversity probes

sources.what_to_extract: Skalse et al. 2022 formal definition; unhackability impossibility theorem; deterministic vs stochastic policy classes; structural mitigations over reward-engineering.
Garrabrant regressional/extremal/causal/adversarial taxonomy; LM failure modes (sycophancy, U-sophistry, ICRH, judge biases); potential-based shaping theorem; mitigation categories.
Zheng 2023 MT-Bench; position bias sweep (GPT-4 flips ~22%, GPT-3.5 ~40%); verbosity bias; self-enhancement bias; 80% agreement parity; reference-guided grading +10 pp.
SL-CAI critique-revise loop; RL-CAI CoT preference labeling; constitution sampled per-critique; helpfulness/harmlessness Pareto; label smoothing [0.25, 0.75].
Contrastive positive/negative prompt preferences from same base model; avoids judge; prompt-engineering sensitivity; mode-collapse gotchas.
RLAIF approx RLHF parity; d-RLAIF reads log-probs; CoT preference prompt +3-5 pp; soft labels; same-size labeler works; labeler-size scaling.
GenRM: critique-then-verdict; log-prob reward; rubric as reward specification; steerable via context; partial mitigation of verbosity/self-enhancement.
Con-J / Self-Taught Evaluators / J1 line; DPO-trained judges; ~40K synthetic pairs; judge self-reinforcement risk; RewardBench leakage caution.
RL amplifies pretraining priors; scale-dependent convergence; implication for attributing 'genuine' gains to reward signal.
Random-reward GRPO +21.4 on MATH-500; clipping-bias amplifies priors; code-reasoning 65%->90%; implies reward informativeness must be audited separately from gain.
